en-US.description: A local-first AI chat desktop app that brings multiple large models into one workbench.
en-US.longDescription:
CCHarness is a local-first, multi-model AI chat desktop app (Tauri 2 + React 18 + Rust) licensed under AGPL-3.0, bringing multiple large models into a single desktop workbench.
It offers seven workflow modes (agent, plan, goal, deep reasoning, review, image generation, and custom state machines), multi-agent collaboration (arena comparison, round-table group chat, named sub-agents), vector long-term memory with automatic reflection, and request-side prefix cache hit rate as a first-class metric. It ships 16+ built-in tools, MCP, Skills, Guardrails safety rails, and multimodal input, supporting DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; API keys are encrypted at the system level.

zh-CN.description: 把多个大模型装进同一个桌面工作台的本地优先 AI 聊天应用。
zh-CN.longDescription:
CCHarness 是一款本地优先的多模型 AI 聊天桌面应用（Tauri 2 + React 18 + Rust），基于 AGPL-3.0 开源，把多个大模型装进同一个桌面工作台。
它提供七种工作流模式（智能体、规划、目标、深度推理、审阅、生图、自定义状态机）、多智能体协作（竞技场对比、圆桌群聊、具名子智能体）、向量长期记忆与自动反思，并把请求侧前缀缓存命中率作为一级指标持续优化。内置 16+ 工具、MCP、Skills、Guardrails 安全护栏与多模态输入，支持 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 及任意 OpenAI 兼容端点；API Key 在系统级加密存储。
